entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Hello, Senpai.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I couldn't really say much[n]out loud at school, but...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I just wanted to let you know[n]again that I'm glad you're safe.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: ...You remember the promise[n]we made on the roof?
Of course.
What was it again?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Really!?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You don't remember...!?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Well, I guess I can't blame you.[n]Considering everything else you[n]had to deal with, I mean.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: We promised we'd go somewhere[n]together once things settled down.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I was so happy this morning—[n]I invited you without really[n]thinking...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But it looks like we can make good[n]on that promise by visiting the[n]shrine.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: ...Thank you for coming back okay.
Sorry to worry you.
I think we're okay.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You don't have to apologize![n]I just wish I could've done more[n]to help...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You only "think" so? That's[n]kind of worrying...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm just hoping nothing else[n]crazy happens.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: As soon as exams are over, I'll be[n]going to a local training camp.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Honestly, I wasn't sure I should[n]go. After all, you were going[n]through so much...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But now I don't have to worry![n]I can finally focus on my training!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Sorry to bother you when we're[n]busy with exams. Talk to you later!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sounds like we really had Yoshizawa[n]worried.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just wish we could get the general public[n]to change their minds about us, too...
